findings.reason: The cited evidence shows the link loss preceded the site failures and no other causes (changes/maintenance) are present, supporting the inference.
T1 explicitly lists two detector alerts overlapping the window in region SFX, including ALR-0014.
T2, ALM-000128, and ALM-000129 all confirm SITE_DOWN alarms on both sites raised at 02:14.
T7 and ALM-000127 confirm the critical LINK_LOS on LNK-SFX-02-A at 02:13, which is one minute before the site failures.
T3, T4, T8, and T9 all report no maintenance or changes for the specified nodes and time window.
T5 and T6 both show S-SFX-002 and S-SFX-006 depending on LNK-SFX-02-A as their parent link.
T2 and T7 show the latest clear time among the cited alarms is 08:35 (ALM-000128), confirming resolution by that time.
